control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
positive communication before approaching mobile equipment
segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: positive isolation verification failure on HT-9003

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on HT-9003 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling traffic on operating areas, specifically applying positive communication before approach. HT-9003 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 14 June 2026 an incident occurred on HT-9003 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during cleaning and preparation, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
